Name: AutoMerge
Author: slpOff
Description:
[b][size=4][center]AutoMerge[/center][/size][/b]AutoMerge is a SMAPI mod for Stardew Valley that automatically merges and applies custom character assets such as hairstyles, clothes, and accessories.

[center][b]*********Key Features******

[/b][/center]***Asset Merging***
Merge multiple PNG files into a single image for in-game use.
Hairstyles are merged in sets of 3 rows per slot, while other assets (clothes, accessories, etc.) are merged in sets of 4 rows per slot.Arranged in rows with a fixed width of 128 pixels.

***In-Game Application***
Merged assets are automatically saved in the Content folder.
Applied automatically when the game starts.Missing files are ignored to prevent errors.

***Ease of Management***
Original PNG files are preserved while using the automatically merged images.
Overwrites merged images for compatibility with existing assets.

***How to Use***
1. Place custom images in the Mods/AutoMerge/assets/ folder.
2. Organize the images into Hairs1, Hairs2, Shirts, and Accessories folders.
3. Launch the game through SMAPI.
4. Assets will be automatically merged and applied when the game starts.
